description: Add the pure, dependency-free, fully-tested frontend helpers that back Issue #20's three capabilities: (a) local-timezone start-time formatting via Intl.DateTimeFormat with distinct EN/JA formats and localized 'Time TBD' handling (criterion 2 + 3); (b) today/tomorrow date-bucketing in the user's local timezone with an injectable `now`; (c) .ics (VCALENDAR/VEVENT) serialization for a game. Every helper accepts explicit timeZone/locale/now so tests are deterministic in a non-Japan sandbox. No React/UI wiring in this feature; that is FEAT-004. Mirror the house style of frontend/src/relativeTime.ts (+ relativeTime.test.ts): colocated *.test.ts, Intl-based, injected inputs, EN+JA coverage.
steps: Create frontend/src/gameTime.ts exporting a pure `formatStartTime` helper with signature like `formatStartTime(startTime: string | undefined, opts: { lang: Lang; timeZone: string; timeTbd?: boolean; tbdLabel: string }): string`. When timeTbd is true OR startTime is undefined/unparseable, return the provided localized tbdLabel (the caller passes t('gametime.tbd')). Otherwise format the instant with new Intl.DateTimeFormat(lang==='ja'?'ja-JP':'en-US', { timeZone, weekday/month/day/hour/minute, hour12 appropriate per locale }) and return the string. Keep it side-effect-free. Import type { Lang } from './i18n' like relativeTime.ts does.

Create frontend/src/gameTime.test.ts: assert formatStartTime for a fixed UTC instant (e.g. '2024-10-01T18:32:00Z') with timeZone 'Asia/Tokyo' vs 'America/New_York' and lang 'ja' vs 'en' produces the expected localized local-time strings (compute expected values via the same Intl API in-test, or assert on stable substrings like the local hour and weekday so the test is robust across ICU versions but still proves tz conversion AND locale differences). Assert the TBD path (timeTbd true, and startTime undefined) returns the passed tbdLabel. Assert an unparseable startTime returns the tbdLabel rather than throwing.

Create frontend/src/upcomingGames.ts with pure functions: `bucketGameDay(startTime: string, now: Date, timeZone: string): 'today' | 'tomorrow' | 'past' | 'future'` that compares the game's calendar day to now's calendar day IN the given timeZone (use Intl.DateTimeFormat with timeZone to extract the y-m-d parts for both instants, then compare). Also add `selectUpcomingGames(bracket, now, timeZone)` returning the games bucketed today/tomorrow (and optionally the soonest future game) across all series, skipping timeTbd/undefined-startTime games. Add `countdownParts(startTime: string, now: Date)` returning { totalMs, days, hours, minutes } clamped at 0 for past/invalid, for a countdown display. Keep everything pure with injected now/timeZone.

Create frontend/src/upcomingGames.test.ts: with a fixed `now` and fixed timeZone (test both 'Asia/Tokyo' and a US zone to prove the day boundary shifts with tz), assert bucketGameDay classifies an instant on the same local day as 'today', the next local day as 'tomorrow', earlier as 'past', later as 'future'; include a case where the UTC date and the Asia/Tokyo local date differ (the date-shift problem the issue calls out) and assert bucketing uses local tz. Assert selectUpcomingGames skips timeTbd games and returns the expected matchups. Assert countdownParts math for a known delta and clamps negatives to 0.

Create frontend/src/ics.ts with a pure `buildIcs(event: { uid: string; start: string; durationMinutes?: number; summary: string; description?: string })` returning a CRLF-joined VCALENDAR string with BEGIN:VCALENDAR/VERSION/PRODID, a VEVENT with UID, DTSTAMP (derive deterministically from start or accept an injected stamp), DTSTART and DTEND in UTC basic format (YYYYMMDDTHHMMSSZ), SUMMARY, DESCRIPTION, END:VEVENT/END:VCALENDAR. Properly escape commas/semicolons/newlines in text fields per RFC5545. Default duration 180 minutes if omitted. Also export a small `gameToIcsEvent(game, high, low, lang, labels)`-style builder OR leave matchup-string construction to the caller in FEAT-004; keep buildIcs itself input->output deterministic.

Create frontend/src/ics.test.ts: feed a FIXED event (fixed uid, start '2024-10-01T18:32:00Z', summary with a comma to prove escaping) and assert the exact DTSTART line ('DTSTART:20241001T183200Z'), the computed DTEND for the default/explicit duration, the SUMMARY line with escaped comma, the UID line, and that lines are CRLF-separated and wrapped in BEGIN/END:VCALENDAR. This is a fixed-input -> fixed-string test.
Run the frontend unit tests to confirm all three new helper suites pass; run the frontend build to confirm strict TS compiles.
acceptance_criteria: formatStartTime uses Intl.DateTimeFormat, converts a UTC instant into the injected timeZone, and renders distinct EN (en-US) vs JA (ja-JP) formats; TBD/undefined input returns the localized label instead of a bogus time (criteria 2 + 3).

bucketGameDay/selectUpcomingGames bucket by local calendar day in the injected timeZone (proven by a UTC-vs-Asia/Tokyo date-shift test case) and skip timeTbd games; countdownParts is correct and clamps negatives to 0.
buildIcs is a deterministic fixed-input -> fixed-string function emitting valid VCALENDAR/VEVENT with correct DTSTART/DTEND/SUMMARY/UID lines, CRLF line endings, and RFC5545 text escaping.
All new *.test.ts suites pass under `npm test -w @mlb/frontend` and the frontend build compiles under strict TS.
Helpers are pure and accept injected now/timeZone/locale so they are deterministic in the non-Japan sandbox.
findings: Added three pure, dependency-free frontend helpers with colocated tests, mirroring relativeTime.ts house style (Intl-based, injected inputs, EN+JA). gameTime.ts/formatStartTime uses Intl.DateTimeFormat('ja-JP'|'en-US', { timeZone, weekday/month/day/hour/minute, hour12: lang!=='ja' }); ja renders a 24h clock (no AM/PM) and en a 12h clock, proving locale divergence; returns tbdLabel for timeTbd/undefined/unparseable and never throws. upcomingGames.ts does local-tz calendar-day bucketing via Intl.DateTimeFormat('en-CA', {timeZone, formatToParts}) -> day-number diff; selectUpcomingGames walks all series in order and skips timeTbd/undefined-start games; countdownParts clamps past/invalid to all-zeros. ics.ts/buildIcs is deterministic input->output: UTC basic-format DTSTART/DTEND (YYYYMMDDTHHMMSSZ), default 180min duration, DTSTAMP derived from start (or injected dtstamp) with NO Date.now(), RFC5545 escaping (backslash->;->,->newline order), CRLF-joined VCALENDAR/VEVENT; throws only on unparseable start. Tests assert tz conversion (Asia/Tokyo vs America/New_York incl. the UTC-vs-local date-shift case), locale difference, TBD/unparseable paths, countdown math+clamp, and exact .ics lines. No React/UI wiring (deferred to FEAT-004). Verified: npm test -w @mlb/frontend (116 passed, 27 new), npm run build -w @mlb/frontend, and full npm run build all green. Note: npm is not on PATH in the sandbox; prefix with PATH="/opt/toolchains/.nvm/versions/node/v22.23.3/bin:$PATH".
